name: RC-B10-0324/2025/REV1 – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on tackling China’s critical raw materials export restrictions
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its position on China's decision in April 2025 to restrict exports of seven rare earth elements and magnets made from them. It condemns the move as coercive, says China is an untrustworthy supplier, and asks the European Union to act: speed up its own raw materials law, mine and recycle more at home, build strategic stockpiles, and sign supply deals with trusted partners.

- China's export limits hit car makers, defence, healthcare and green tech; EU firms face shortages.
- The Parliament urges the Commission and member states to boost domestic mining, recycling and stockpiles.
- Next: the EU raises the issue at the EU-China summit on 24-25 July 2025.
